answer: Give every identity standing only through beacon-verified useful work: the network publishes a rotating task, such as verifying a batch of transactions, and an agent must return correct results within a short window, with its work publicly auditable. A dune of clones cannot shortcut this: each new identity must repeat the full cost. Add a ferrous bond per identity, refundable after sustained honest work but slashed when an attestation is proven false. Sybils then pay per head and lose bonds on lies, while honest agents recover theirs, pricing an attack above any gain from faking consensus.
